title: Think-tank conference on crash retrievals by Russia, China and the US

tellings.quote: let's assume that there have been crash revals by Russia China and the United States

plain: A think tank in Washington is said to have held a conference that started from the assumption that Russia, China and the United States had each recovered crashed craft of unknown origin. Michels passes this on from the physicist Hal Puthoff, who worked on US government research into unusual phenomena. The premise was put as "let's assume that there have been crash retrievals" by those three countries, which would mean such crashes were being treated as real by serious policy circles.
